name: Isang Bangkang Malaya
description: The club's first international racing debut, going up against crews from across the region.

result.notes: 4th place on debut — the result that set the stage for a Malaysia campaign.

name: Penang Mini Dragonboat Race
description: Malaysia debut — 27 paddlers across four categories, racing hot weather and choppy open-sea conditions that capsized or scattered several other crews.

result.notes: Bronze medal — the club's first Malaysia-debut podium.
